experiment.comment: Recommended simulation settings based on the paper: isothermal-isobaric.
T-profiles were obtained by using the T-profile calculator provided by the authors in the Supplementary Material.
The volumetric flow rate was reported to be 500 SCCM. "Standard" conditions were considered as T_0 = 273.15 K and p_0 = 1 bar.
The uncertainties of the major species measured by EI-MBMS (NH3, H2, O2, H2O, N2) are reported to be between 40-50%. The conservative estimation, 50%, was applied here.
Tabulated experimental data were obtained through personal communication with the authors.
Although the length of the reactor is reported to be 130 cm, the published temperature profiles span between 0-145 cm; therefore, 145 cm length was assumed for the reactor.
